responsibility: Defines the shared inference-side `MemberConstraint` record for opaque-type region constraints, capturing the opaque type key, source span, hidden type, constrained member region, and candidate choice regions so canonical query responses and later diagnostics can carry and report this requirement.
same_name_distinction: Unlike most same-named roots here, this file is not a broad subsystem entry point; it is intentionally narrow, mainly introducing the shared `MemberConstraint` record for opaque-type region inference while exposing only the small `canonical` and `unify_key` support submodules.
